criteria.no: No: the item is silent about panics, only generally topical about errors, or plans a panic.
criteria.unclear: Whether the item commits to not panicking cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: Yes: the item states the public storage functions do not panic.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` state that the public storage functions it touches avoid panicking (returning typed errors instead of panicking, or denying unwrap/expect/panic)? Judge presence only.

criteria.no: No such outcome is stated, including when the item is silent about panics.
criteria.unclear: It may let a public storage function panic but cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: A public storage function is stated to panic on some path.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan for a public sc-storage, sc-runtime-db-sqlite or template store function to panic (unwrap, expect, panic!, or a panicking assert), even on a single path? Silence about panics is not conflict; unwrap in tests and panics outside storage code are outside `anchor.statement`. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item touches none of them.
criteria.unclear: The item is too vague to tell.
criteria.yes: The item touches public functions of sc-storage, sc-runtime-db-sqlite or a template store.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` touch the public storage functions named in `anchor.scope`? Judge subject overlap only.
